title: CAD Wgpu Premigration Parity
description: Restore CAD premigration feature set inside wgpu/Rust plugin stack per plan cad_wgpu_premigration_parity_85c19a7c.
summary: Restored CAD premigration feature parity in the wgpu/Rust plugin stack. Extended cad_document with full CadObject/CadScene schema (primitives, locked, references, per-pane objects), comprehensive CadOp variants (add/remove/patch/translate/rotate/scale/setPane/setReferences), and VCS-backed undo/redo for all object edits. Updated cad/plugin/rs to route mutations through VCS, wire hierarchy chrome (hover/actions/draggable/primitive children), multi-selection inspector with mixed-value fields, world reference overlays via world3d_scene_extended, transformation toolbar with applyTransformation, save/load JSON export commands, and per-pane engagement REPL with possible typology engagements. Fixed forest fixture model index mapping (shape=0, building=1, energy=2, structure-classic=3). Tests: 17 cad-plugin + 3 cad_document passing.
